title: Multi-Resolution Masked Self-Supervised Speech Pretraining for Robust, Sample-Efficient ASR
one_liner: Pretrain a wav2vec2-style model on LibriSpeech with multi-resolution masking, then quantify sample-efficiency and noise-robustness gains vs strong supervised and standard-SSL baselines.
research_question: Does multi-resolution masking (coarse waveform span masking + fine latent feature masking with a curriculum) improve (1) sample efficiency when fine-tuning on limited labeled speech and (2) robustness to additive noise/reverberation, compared to standard wav2vec2 masking and a supervised Conformer-CTC baseline on LibriSpeech?

dataset.name: LibriSpeech (OpenSLR SLR12) + MUSAN (OpenSLR SLR17) + RIRS_NOISES (OpenSLR SLR28) for controlled corruption
dataset.ingestion_notes: Download sequentially (OpenSLR rate-limits parallel fetches). Verify with OpenSLR checksums where available. Extract under data/ (FLAC audio + transcripts). Build manifests (path, duration, transcript, speaker, chapter) and deterministic splits using official LibriSpeech subsets. Generate corrupted evaluation sets by mixing MUSAN noise at SNR {5,10,20} dB and convolving with RIRS (real+sim), keeping clean test sets untouched.

method.model: PyTorch DDP wav2vec2-style SSL pretraining on 16kHz waveforms: conv feature encoder + Transformer encoder; contrastive objective with a quantized target codebook. Proposed change: Multi-Resolution Masking (MRM) that combines (a) standard time-span masking over latent frames, (b) additional fine-grained feature-channel masking, and (c) a curriculum that increases masked span length and mask probability over training to stabilize early learning. Fine-tune with CTC for ASR; optional shallow-fusion n-gram LM for decoding parity across runs.
baseline: Supervised baseline: log-mel frontend + Conformer encoder + CTC (SpecAugment), trained on train-clean-100 and train-clean-360; evaluate on test-clean/test-other.
SSL baseline: identical wav2vec2 architecture and training budget but with standard wav2vec2 masking only (no feature masking, no curriculum).
ablations: Remove feature-channel masking (MRM -> time-span only) while keeping curriculum.
Remove curriculum (fixed mask prob/span from step 0) while keeping feature masking.
Robustness ablation: train/fine-tune without any noise/RIR augmentation; evaluate on corrupted test sets to isolate robustness coming from representation learning vs augmentation.
metrics: Primary: Word Error Rate (WER) on LibriSpeech test-clean and test-other.
Robustness: WER on noisy+reverberant variants (MUSAN SNR 5/10/20 dB; RIRS convolution).
Sample efficiency: WER vs labeled fine-tuning hours (1h, 10h, 100h from train-clean-100 with fixed seeds).
Efficiency: GPU-hours, training throughput (updates/sec), and peak VRAM for each configuration.

risks: SSL pretraining can be unstable without careful LR/batch/gradient scaling; may require a short hyperparameter sweep.
Full 460h+ pretraining is still compute-heavy on 2x3090; throughput may bottleneck on audio decoding unless dataloader caching and worker tuning are done.
Noise/RIR corruption pipelines can accidentally leak test audio into training if manifests are mishandled; must enforce split integrity.
WER differences may be small; multiple seeds are needed for credible conclusions, increasing total runtime.
execution_steps: Create repo skeleton with reproducible env (requirements/lock), configs, and a single entrypoint CLI (train/pretrain/finetune/eval).
Install CUDA-enabled PyTorch + torchaudio, plus deps (hydra/omegaconf, sentencepiece or unigram tokenizer, jiwer, soundfile, pyarrow, tensorboard/wandb optional).
Run downloader that fetches LibriSpeech+MUSAN+RIRS from the URLs (sequential), verifies checksums, and extracts to data/.
Build manifests for each official split and precompute durations; cache decoded audio chunks or use torchaudio + file-level caching to avoid repeated FLAC decode overhead.
Train supervised Conformer-CTC baseline; decode with a consistent beam search (optionally with an OpenSLR LibriSpeech LM if you choose to add it later).
Pretrain SSL baseline (standard wav2vec2 masking) on train-clean-100+train-clean-360; log throughput and checkpoints.
Pretrain proposed MRM variant with identical architecture/budget; then fine-tune both SSL models with CTC on labeled subsets (1h/10h/100h).
Generate corrupted test sets (noise+RIR) deterministically; evaluate all models on clean and corrupted sets; compute WER and confidence intervals via bootstrap over utterances.
Run ablations (feature masking off, curriculum off, no augmentation) with the same seeds and budgets; produce a single report table and plots (WER vs hours, WER vs SNR).
